goal: Make AI-Workflow installable and usable through multiple agent runtimes without coupling the core to any named agent.
safety_invariants: The core workflow must not require OpenCode or any other named runtime.
Explicit adapter selection must never silently fall back to another adapter.
Automatic adapter selection must be deterministic and recorded in evidence.
AI-Workflow must not install an agent runtime without explicit user consent.
AI-Workflow must not store raw runtime, provider, or GitHub secrets.
The no-secret demo must complete without provider authentication.
Unknown adapter capabilities must be reported as unknown and fail closed for claims.
Generic command support must not claim runtime-specific safety or evidence.
Target initialization must not copy secrets into the target project.
Target modifications must have a backup and rollback boundary before implementation.
The selected adapter ID must be included in run-manifest evidence.
Website adapter claims must be generated from source-owned catalog data.
